rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.04 is extremely compressed, making it nearly impossible to construct a trade with meaningful reward relative to any realistic stop distance — even a 1-cent adverse move consumes a significant portion of potential gain. While the anomalous volume spike on the fourth-to-last candle (~1.63M shares vs. the surrounding 20–30k bars) is noteworthy and could indicate institutional absorption near the day's low, the price barely reacted (range of ~$0.02), offering no directional resolution. With session VWAP far overhead at $93.13 and the ATR too tight to generate usable invalidation and profit levels, there is no identifiable mechanical edge to justify entry in either direction.
